# `Q-2-21` — Unclosed Editorial Comment

> An editorial-comment span opens with `[>>` but no closing `]`
> appears before the end of the block.

## What this means

The editorial-comment form `[>>a remark]` attaches a non-output
side note to text. This error fires when the opener `[>>` has no
matching close.

## Why this happens

A deleted closing bracket, or a literal `[>>` taken as an
editorial opener.

## How to fix

Add the closing `]`, or escape the opening bracket: `\[>>text]`.

## Example

```markdown
[>>
```
